gmv.name: GMV
gmv.formula: CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND item_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN item_amount END) END
gmv.sample: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND item_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
gmv.definition: 有效订单商品金额，不含运费；缺少有效订单金额时不输出总额

orders.name: 有效订单量
orders.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
orders.sample: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
orders.definition: 排除 canceled/unavailable，每单一行后计数

aov.name: 客单价
aov.formula: CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND item_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN item_amount END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) END
aov.sample: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
aov.definition: GMV / 同口径有效订单量

cancellation_rate.name: 取消率
cancellation_rate.formula: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
cancellation_rate.definition: 已取消订单 / 全部创建订单；不可履约订单单列

delivery_days.name: 平均交付时长
delivery_days.definition: 已交付且时间有效订单，创建至实际交付的平均天数

review_score.name: 平均评分
review_score.definition: 每个订单最新一条有效评价的平均分；无评价不计入分母

amount.name: 订单商品金额（不含运费）
